title: See ice? Now you dont!

vibeProfile.oneLine: Green Humour cartoons on vanishing ice and a warming planet.

summary: A themed collection of Rohan Chakravarty's Green Humour cartoons centred on the frozen world and its rapid disappearance, using the vanishing of polar and glacial ice as a lens on climate change. With his signature wit, Chakravarty turns melting ice, threatened polar wildlife and warming seas into cartoons that are funny, pointed and quietly alarming. A clever, accessible way to grasp one of the most visible signs of a heating planet, from India's best-loved wildlife cartoonist.
whyReadIt: Green Humour on melting ice and a warming world. Funny, pointed and quietly alarming.

funFacts.text: The title plays on the way polar and glacial ice is rapidly disappearing.
